quintal: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new production overworld background for original Brazilian 2D creature-and-kite RPG PipaKlub, landscape 3:2, high quality. Input 1 old courtyard is IDENTITY reference: keep its modest clubhouse veranda, terracotta tiled roof, teal wooden door, racks of colorful handmade paper kites, spools, central grass, back gate, orange merchant awning, stone summoning circle, friends bench and noticeboard. Input 2 recent coastal plaza is ONLY rendering finish and elevated RPG camera reference. Do NOT reproduce its port, boats, ocean-front resort, giant blue guild building, street layout or tiled central plaza. Reimagine the ORIGINAL intimate club backyard with this readable elevated 2D RPG camera, consistent medium-sized building geometry and walkable terrain. All objects at one coherent scale: human sprite will be 65px tall on a 1536x1024 canvas, doors about 85px tall, no miniature houses. Entire map is a single enclosed Brazilian neighborhood courtyard. Cream handmade clubhouse with teal door and orange roof occupying upper-left x8-38% y15-43%; wooden kite display on its veranda. Small training workbench at x23% y52%. Big wooden gate in back wall centered x51% y25%, opens to a hint of Kronasta hillside homes and green hills beyond, no ocean or landmark copied from real city. Clearly visible traversable sandy fork from gate at x51 y36 down through broad grassy clearing center x50 y58 to bottom x50 y95; branches reach veranda left x30y48, merchant stall right x78y40 with orange cloth awning, flat circular old stone kite-diamond ritual pad right x78y63, friends bulletin board and wooden bench lower right x79y83. Sandy paths must visibly connect all these places with no fences/steps interrupting routes, at least 65px wide. Paths do not go underneath buildings. Large simple low grass clearing central left x30-63% y50-82% free for animated companions. Old boundary walls, bougainvillea, banana leaves and backyard fruit trees at edges. Hand repaired paper kites, bamboo sticks and ribbon details give identity; lived-in warm Brazilian home, not generic fantasy kingdom. Orthographic-ish elevated 3/4 RPG viewpoint looking north, clear outlines, restrained pixel clusters within clean 2D cel shading, flat 2-3 tones, sun warm from upper left, no glossy 3D, no photorealistic texture, no dramatic sky horizon taking up space. Full-bleed opaque illustration, NO people, NO creatures, NO labels, NO lettering, NO UI, NO borders, NO baked magic effects. Keep foreground pathways unobstructed. Cozy welcoming place of learning and caring for paper souls.
morro: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW playable exploration overworld background for original Brazilian 2D kite-creature RPG PipaKlub, landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024. First input is the existing Morro do Sol map as IDENTITY reference; second is the newly designed club backyard as STYLE, MATERIALS and SCALE reference. NOT an edit, not a collage. One coherent small sunny Brazilian hillside district, walkable connected terraces, plaster pastel houses with handmade terracotta roofs, exposed brick patches, teal doors, short retaining walls, blue water tanks, backyard plants in reused tins, warm cream sunlight, green shade trees. Same crisp clean dark outline, flat 2-3 tone cel shading and refined pixel clusters as backyard. Elevated orthographic 3/4 RPG camera, modest perspective, NO panoramic skyline. Houses are large enough for humans: a 60px-tall sprite, doors 75px tall at this image scale. Do not fill it with dozens of miniature houses. About 8-10 houses frame the routes, all sensible geometry. Keep paths broad 60-90px and unobstructed, stairs wide with accessible landings, no impossible stairs leading through walls, no paths that end in cliffs. FIVE distinctive actual traversable spaces, exact relative layout and connectivity: 1 lower-left arrival plaza centered x18% y80%, sandy stone plaza with small wooden entrance gate at bottom-left and a simple kite diamond floor pattern, a bench at perimeter. 2 shaded stair landing center x28% y49%, a big leafy tree left of wide visible stairs that connect from arrival plaza up to this landing, mural of a paper kite on a low wall behind. 3 central flat rooftop terrace of a coral house centered x49% y62%, low safety parapet, clear floor, small spool worktable at its back edge; the terrace is reachable by a wide external stair FROM shaded landing and has a clear unobstructed route on its right edge to the next uphill path. 4 upper-middle water-tank lookout centered x63% y29%, one BLUE WATER TANK on a small house behind the lookout patio, wooden guardrail, wide S-shaped uphill stairs connecting from the right edge of central terrace to the lookout. 5 right-side public wind park centered x82% y51%, open roughly circular dirt/grass play area with a simple tiled pavilion and ribbons on far-right edge, benches at boundary. A broad descending path links lookout patio down to the left entry of park, and another broad path links park down around the LOWER RIGHT of coral terrace back toward arrival area to form a visible loop. Distinguish elevations through retaining walls and stairs, not floating platforms. The road itself is part of art, never draw dotted trail routes or mission arrows. Important open route at approximate x18y80 -> x24y64 -> x28y49 -> x40y52 -> x49y62 -> x61y54 -> x63y29 -> x73y30 -> x82y51. Include visible external stairs wherever this route changes height, no rooftop doors without access. Environmental storytelling through worn stucco, patched paper kites hung on veranda racks, ribbon scraps in a workshop basket; charm from real use, no fantasy guild castle, no coastal resort or marina. Full opaque game world, no people, NO creatures, no baked interactive effects, no UI, NO text or letters, no labels, no numbering, no map borders or legend. No cropped essential landmarks. Readable walking floor more important than ornamental vegetation. Consistent sunlight and building scale throughout.
morroAccessCorrection: Edit this existing PipaKlub exploration map, preserving the entire design, layout, exact camera, illustration style and all five landmarks.
